description: A collection of data for a piece of written, printed or electronic matter that is exchanged between two parties as a formal declaration.

additionalStatementNote.description: An additional statement note for this exchanged declaration.

applicableCustomsValuation.description: Customs valuation information applicable to this exchanged declaration.

associatedDocument.description: A referenced document associated with this exchanged declaration.

currencyExchangeRate.description: The rate of currency exchange in this exchanged declaration.

customsValueSpecifiedAmount.description: The monetary value specified for customs purposes in this exchanged declaration.

declarantAgentParty.description: The trade party acting as an agent for the declarant for this exchanged declaration.

declarantParty.description: The trade party acting as the declarant for this exchanged declaration.

documentTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of this exchanged declaration.

grossWeightSpecifiedMeasure.description: The gross weight measure specified in this exchanged declaration.

identifier.description: An identifier for this exchanged declaration.

issueDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the issuance of this exchanged declaration.

jurisdictionEntryDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value when the items which are a subject of this exchanged declaration enter a jurisdiction, such as the actual date of arrival of a means of transport.

previousDocument.description: A previous document referenced for this exchanged declaration.

principalAssociatedParty.description: A principal trade party associated with this exchanged declaration.

procedureCode.description: A code specifying a procedure for this exchanged declaration.

specificCircumstanceCode.description: The code specifying a specific circumstance in this exchanged declaration.

statisticalValueSpecifiedAmount.description: The monetary value specified for statistical purposes in this exchanged declaration.

submissionLocation.description: The submission location for this exchanged declaration.

totalInvoiceSpecifiedAmount.description: The total invoice monetary value specified in this exchanged declaration.

totalPackageSpecifiedQuantity.description: The total package quantity specified in this exchanged declaration.

versionId.description: The identifier for the version of this exchanged declaration.
